title: Character and Goal · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Character and Goal · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Write a character and a harmless goal on two slips. The lead tells a short story in which the character tries to achieve the goal. The story includes the character, the goal and an outcome. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Character and Goal, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The story includes the character, the goal and an outcome.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The story includes the character, the goal and an outcome.
